Score It or Skip It: A Framework for Fast Deal Evaluation

*********************************************************

Sponsored by Acquisition Lab Capital, Daniel Duran leads a webinar on how SMB buyers can quickly evaluate acquisition opportunities before wasting time on deals that will never close.

* Why most searchers evaluate deals backwards — and how to fix it.

* The three pillars of deal scoring: Target Quality, Deal Structure, and Buyer Fit.

* Key business quality signals including margins, customer concentration, and transition risk.

* How to evaluate seller financing, add-backs, working capital, and deal terms.

* A live walkthrough scoring a real deal from first look to IC decision.

* Practical frameworks to help buyers stop chasing the wrong deals.
